| # VDD5_IN ECU internal reference voltage {#vdd5_in-ecu-internal-reference-voltage-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                   |                                                                                                                                                            |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The cyclic check of the ECU internal voltage through voltage divider via input.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Monitoring of overvoltage and undervoltage for error.

- Only Errors are indicated.

- Over Voltage Error Limit = 5.060V

- Under Voltage Error Limit = 4.940V

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

 

- Over Voltage Error (VDD5_IN \> Over Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ -----------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_OV_VDD5_IN
  Error Code                     0x082600
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  100ms

 

 

- Under Voltage Error (VDD5_IN  \< Under Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ -----------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_UV_VDD5_IN
  Error Code                     0x082700
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  100ms
